_meta.name: Kamilight — Phase 4: Customer Lifecycle Automation
_meta.description: Weekly/monthly messaging to active and past clients for retention, repeat business, and re-engagement

weekly_check_in.message: Good morning {name}! Hope your week is starting well. Any freight needs we can help with this week? We're here. — Kamilight Team

monthly_update.message: Hi {name}, a quick update from Kamilight — we've expanded to new routes this month. Your business deserves the best options. Let us know if you'd like to review your logistics plan.

quarterly_reengagement.message: Hello {name}, it's been a while since we worked together. We've improved a lot — faster routes, better pricing. Can we reconnect and explore how we can serve you again?

shipment_anniversary.message: Hi {name}, it's been a great journey partnering with Kamilight. Thank you for your continued trust. We're committed to keeping your supply chain moving.
